patterns.message: A dependency is used through its export map. If the package exports no subpath for what you need, patch its package.json under patches/ (bun patchedDependencies) and say so there; never reach through the installed tree.

paths.name: @cloudflare/sandbox
paths.message: Reach a sandbox through `openSandbox` (packages/cf-backend/src/sandbox-exec-lane.ts). It fixes the transport, which the SDK persists per sandbox; a client naming another loses its in-flight requests.

paths.name: ai
paths.message: Invoke a model through packages/core/src/providers/model-invocation.ts (generateReported, streamTextReported): each takes the spend it reports, so the call reaches the workspace total. Exempt, each for a property of its code: core/src/chat.ts is the turn loop, whose steps reach the total as step_finish, so a model_call row would count them twice; core/src/mcts/rollout.ts hands its usage back to the MCTS engine, which reports it on both backends because the CLI's branch worker has no sink, only IPC; cli/src/agent-create.ts names a workspace before it exists, so no workspace ledger exists to report to.

no-restricted-properties.message: Read the Workers AI binding in packages/core/src/providers/model-invocation.ts, where each utility call (an embedding, an HTML conversion) is counted as `platform` spend. Exempt: core/src/providers/ai-gateway.ts, cf-backend/src/providers/agent-registry.ts and cf-backend/src/user/ai-proxy.ts hand the binding to an AI SDK transport, and the model call made over it reports the spend.

A provider model's doGenerate spends without reaching the workspace total; call a model through packages/core/src/providers/model-invocation.ts. Exempt: core/src/providers/catalog.ts, the adapter that forwards a resolved model's calls, and test-utils/src/turn-model.ts, the scripted model tests run on.
